components_strategy.booking_calendar: Shadcn Calendar - Customized with dark purple background (#10071C), #D4AF37 active states, zero border radius (sharp corporate edges).
components_strategy.paywall_card: Glassmorphism card with a heavy backdrop-blur overlay over the 'transcript' content area. Lock icon in #D4AF37. Solid black CTA button with gold border.
components_strategy.blog_preview: Bento grid item (col-span-4). Image heavy with dark gradient overlay. Cinzel title for the mystical/new age touch.
components_strategy.video_conference_badge: Subtle pulsing golden dot next to 'Google Meet Ready' text, using Ping animation.

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtle grain/noise overlay across the entire site to give a tactile, ancient manuscript feel.
visual_enhancers.celtic_motifs: Use highly subtle, absolute-positioned SVG Celtic knots in the background of sections, fill='white', opacity-5. Break symmetry to avoid generic looks.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Use radial gradients in the background to simulate deep purple ambient lighting (e.g., bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[#2A0A4A]/20 via-[#050505] to-[#050505])

hero_background.description: Abstract golden light against black. Use as a heavily darkened background image with a dark purple gradient overlay for the Hero section.

services_tarot.description: Close up of tarot reading. Use in the 'Consultation Services' or 'About' bento card.

case_study_atmosphere.description: Luxurious golden ornaments. Use for the 'Downloadable Case Studies' section background.

blog_mystic.description: Mystical tarot and candles. Use as a thumbnail for the Wiccan/New Age Blog previews.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Google Fonts: 'Cinzel' (for headings) and 'Outfit' (for body).
Implement the 'Aethera' consulting site as a dark-mode-only experience using the #050505 and #2A0A4A palettes.
Use Tailwind's generic grid utilities but apply the 'Tetris' bento logic for the case studies and blog previews (e.g., col-span-8 for featured case study, col-span-4 for standard).

For the booking calendar, use Shadcn Calendar but override its default styling: make backgrounds deep purple/black (#10071C), text white, and the selected date golden (#D4AF37) with black text. Use sharp edges (`rounded-none`).
Ensure the hero section uses the `hero_background` image with an overlay of `bg-gradient-to-b from-black/60 via-[#1A0B2E]/60 to-[#050505]` to maintain readability of the golden/white text.
In the transcripts section, simulate a Stripe paywall by blurring the content (`blur-sm` or `blur-md`) and placing a clear CTA to 'Unlock Transcript' centered over the blurred area.
Make sure button hovers use a brightness or slight glow effect, avoid changing the gold color to a generic blue or purple.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all forms, calendar dates, and CTAs.
